framework: South Dakota state academic standards: Health Education

units.title: Students will comprehend concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention to enhance health

topics.title: Students will comprehend concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention to enhance health

subtopics.title: Students will comprehend concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention to enhance health (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Predict how healthy behaviors can affect health status.
Describe the interrelationships of emotional, mental, physical, and social health.
Analyze how environment and personal health are interrelated.
Analyze how genetics and family history can affect personal health.
Propose ways to reduce or prevent injuries and health problems.

subtopics.title: Students will comprehend concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention to enhance health (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Analyze the relationship between access to health care and health status.
Compare and contrast the benefits of and barriers to practicing a variety of healthy behaviors.
Analyze personal susceptibility to injury, illness, or death if engaging in unhealthy behaviors.
Analyze the potential severity of injury or illness if engaging in unhealthy behaviors.

outcomes.text: Analyze how the family influences the health of individuals.
